phases.name: CustomScaffold global screen surface
actions: Create lib/core/widgets/scaffold/custom_scaffold/ with public CustomScaffold plus the Background, Body, SafeArea, Overlay, Loading, Constants and Exports submodules.
CustomScaffold wraps Material Scaffold (so SnackBars / dialogs / focus traversal keep working) and composes background → body → overlay → loading via a Stack.
Body slot owns SafeArea, padding (custom or responsive via ButtonResponsiveSize), optional SingleChildScrollView with ClampingScrollPhysics, optional fadeUpEntrance via AppAnimateExtensions.
Background paints a solid theme colour plus an optional gradient and optional blurred image. Never wraps content in LiquidGlassEffect — that is a separate surface concern.
Overlay is a Positioned.fill slot used to host chrome (e.g. modals, banners, loading). Loading flag paints a hairline-glass disc with a themed spinner inside the overlay stack.
All tokens read from LiquidTheme, AppSizes, AppAnims, AppRadius, ButtonResponsiveSize and the scaffold's own constants file. Nothing hardcoded.

Replace direct Scaffold usage in features/splash, features/onboarding, features/dashboard with CustomScaffold. Splash moves its gradient into the background slot; onboarding uses scrollable:true so the LayoutBuilder + IntrinsicHeight dance can be removed; home dashboard passes appBar + padding.
Delete the empty placeholder lib/core/widgets/scaffold/custom_scaffold.dart now that the real files live one level deeper.
Update plans/mvvm_architecture.json with the customScaffold module description, dependency flow, and consumption pattern.
Run flutter analyze — no new issues.
future_milestones: Phase 11: Migrate every remaining feature screen to CustomScaffold (auth, settings, profile, photo gallery).
Phase 12: Add overlay-based promo / announcement chrome across the app using the overlay slot.
Phase 13: Add a CustomScaffoldDark helper that pins a dark surface for splash / branded screens via forceDarkBackground.
Phase 14: Add a Hero-aware variant for screens that animate between routes with custom transitions.

Create lib/core/widgets/scaffold/liquid_scaffold_extensions/ — BuildContext extension (LiquidScaffoldContextX) exposing context.liquidScaffoldTheme and context.hasLiquidScaffoldTheme.

Create lib/core/widgets/scaffold/liquid_background/ — AmbientBackgroundStyle value object, LiquidLightBlobsPainter (CustomPainter), LiquidBackground widget with internal SingleTickerProviderStateMixin AnimationController that drives slow blob drift (default 18s, reverse: true).
Create lib/core/widgets/scaffold/liquid_safe_area/ — LiquidSafeArea wrapper around SafeArea with per-edge flags + transparent color default.
Create lib/core/widgets/scaffold/liquid_body/ — LiquidBody composer (SafeArea → padding → scroll → entrance) + LiquidBodyDefaults constants.
Create lib/core/widgets/scaffold/liquid_overlay/ — LiquidOverlay (Positioned.fill with optional scrim), LiquidLoading (centred hairline-glass disc spinner), LiquidOverlayDefaults.

Create lib/core/widgets/scaffold/liquid_scaffold/ — LiquidScaffold host widget (title/subtitle AppBar shortcut, errorState/emptyState priority, Material chrome passthroughs, ambient bootstrap) + LiquidScaffoldDefaults + barrel re-exporting every sibling module.
Migrate features/splash/presentation/screens/splash_screen.dart — replace CustomScaffold with LiquidScaffold (gradient, padding, body).

Migrate features/onboarding/presentation/screens/onboarding_screen.dart — replace CustomScaffold with LiquidScaffold (padding: EdgeInsets.zero, body keeps its existing LayoutBuilder + IntrinsicHeight wrapper for Spacer semantics).
Migrate features/dashboard/presentation/screens/home_dashboard_screen.dart — replace CustomScaffold with LiquidScaffold (appBar, padding, body).

Update plans/mvvm_architecture.json — replace the custom_scaffold section with a comprehensive liquid_scaffold section documenting every module, folder structure, dependency flow, consumption pattern and strict rules (no raw Scaffold, no business logic).
Update plans/mvvm_migration_plan.json — append phase 11 with the actions above.

rationale.feature_first: Each feature is the smallest releasable unit. Cross-feature concerns are pushed into core/ and shared/.
rationale.use_case_layer: Business operations are first-class. ViewModels stay thin and depend on UseCases, not Repositories.
rationale.data_source_split: Remote and Local datasources are strictly separate. Repositories orchestrate them. DTOs are confined to data/models/.
rationale.riverpod: Single state-management library. No setState for business logic. Providers live next to the layer they expose.
rationale.no_widget_domain_reach: Widgets only depend on presentation/viewmodels/. They never reach into Firebase or Firestore.
rationale.glass_ui_library: A premium, reusable design-system layer that future features can compose against without re-implementing glass surfaces. Independent of business logic, presentation-only, fully responsive, light/dark adaptive, and built on top of the project's existing design tokens.
